body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below — every level a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity on non-current maps**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection, foreign types in method bodies only. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. See-below / cross-gap is ONLY sky<->surface; basement routing-only.
- Basement solid rock; with Biomes! Caverns = living cavern.
- Stairwells do NOT exchange heat (run-14).
- Sky-view mountain = ONE connected vanilla rock texture per stone type (run #17); **BM variant mode is the sanctioned exception (USER-VERIFIED)**.
- **OUTERMOST RING OF ANY SKY MASS IS ALWAYS AB_MountainTop lip**; hidden-valley breach notches preserve this.
- **MINED PEAK EXPOSES OPEN SKY**: `level == 1` gates must become "topmost level" if more levels land.
- **Pod transit handoff LATE**: HandoffTicksToImpact = 22.
- **DEPTH/HEIGHT CUES RETIRED (run #50)**: below view PLUMB, dim 0.06, hairlines, reveal.
- **Mesa model rejected**; stacked maps stay.
- **ALWAYS read `def.graphicData.Graphic`, never the stale `def.graphic` field** (run-53; lore).
- **Settings IMGUI discipline**: deferred tab/expando switches, snapshot-gated rows, maxOneColumn + measured heights + unconditional gutter.
- **Cross-level work migrates only for STRICTLY better-ranked work**; equal rank stays local (user-approved 2026-07-22). Async/actors/AOT rejected — main-thread sim only.
- **CrossLevelDemand skips Blueprint_Install** (fixed + verified run #62).
- **TEXTURE POLICY (2026-07-22)**: user supplies ALL stair/ladder/elevator art. Stairs/grand/wide/ladders rotatable; elevator NOT. Risers: host-mod linked atlases, no custom art.
- **Climb animations: vanilla pipeline only (2026-07-23, user-approved)**.
- **Cross-map job guard doctrine (run #70)**: any third-party giver that binds a target (station/bed/bench) may emit unstartable cross-map jobs once our stairs move pawns — intercept non-null results whose targetA.Map != pawn.Map, replace with routing or NoJob. Lore saved (compat + debugging).

## RUN #70 FIXES (2026-07-23) — APPLIED + compile green, need relaunch to verify
### Robots++ dock error loop (user-visible, recurring reserve errors)
X2_JobGiver_RechargeEnergyIdle is a raw ThinkNode (TryIssueJobPackage) — our DeclaredMethod("TryGiveJob") silently resolved null, type was NEVER patched; and it emits GoAndWait/GoRecharge at the bound station with NO map check -> cross-map reservation fails -> error loop. Fix in ABMiscRobotsCompat: routing core extracted to `RouteHome(pawn)`; ctor patches BOTH shapes per giver type (TryGiveJob -> Job postfix; else TryIssueJobPackage -> ThinkResult postfix). ThinkResult postfix: empty result -> RouteHome; non-null job targeting a thing on ANOTHER map -> replace with stairs-home job or ThinkResult.NoJob (kills the error loop even when no stairs).
### Fence patch dead (startup patching exception, run #70 warning)
Patch_ABFence_CanSpawnAt prefix params renamed def/loc -> thingDef/c to match vanilla names (Harmony binds by name); now also injects `Rot4? rot` and uses rot ?? defaultPlacingRot ?? North for RectOk. Landmark fence CanSpawnAt steering active again (Spawn backstop had been covering).
### Still open from run #70 triage
- "Translation data for language English has 4 errors" — audit pending (no duplicate AB_ keys found by grep; may be another mod's or def-level).
- Palette pin "Could not find node from path 'As above\AB: ensure sky + basement'" — pin failed to resolve in run #70 only; dev actions reachable via debug Actions menu manually. Watch next run.
- Misc Robots' GoAndWait/GoRecharge ×1 pairs early in run were the same cross-map emission — covered by the fix.

## 2026-07-23 TRANCHE 3 — BUILT (Robots++ work migration via X2_JobGiver_Work postfix + summary gating; "Bring {material} and build {thing}" forced cross-level construct order with FinishOnSite arrival continuation). Run #70 verified the ERROR PATH only; behavior verification pending relaunch.
## BIOME-DRIVEN SKY PLATEAUS — BUILT: arable band via terrainsByFertility@0.7 + fallbacks; vanilla unchanged; modded-biome check needs matching tile session.
## JOB-SCAN SETTINGS TAB — BUILT: presets + 4 sliders + 4 flow checkboxes, all consts settings-driven; Blueprint.SpawnSetup instant invalidation.
## 2026-07-23 TRANCHE 2 — Achtung drags, meditation redirect, construction supply giver — BUILT, behavior check pending.
## ART TUNER — BUILT; bake fold-in pending. CLIMB ANIMATIONS + WIDE STAIRS — BUILT, check pending.
## MECH ESCORT FOLLOW — BUILT 2026-07-22, awaiting check.
## PRIORITY-AWARE CROSS-LEVEL WORK — USER-VERIFIED run #62. MISC. ROBOTS BASE — USER-VERIFIED run #62.
## SETTINGS SUITE — six tabs. Below-view rendering USER-VERIFIED. COMPAT verified: sky biome inheritance; MO formations; BM variant mode. PARITY COMPLETE.

## Dev-tools ("As above")
ensure sky+basement; self-test suite; below-view diagnostic; probe ledge cell; cap corner fillers; DEV: Adjust art.

## Prior verified features (unchanged)
Select in place; bidirectional right-click orders; merged colonist bar; stairs/elevators; cross-level power/pipes; work/haul/supply/needs/medical/prisoners; see-below renderer; opt-in threats; world integration; modder API.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE risers. Biomes! Caverns (soft). Better Mountains + Medieval Overhaul (verified). Odyssey landmarks + VLE (soft). Misc. Robots (verified) + Robots++ (work migration + dock-loop fix, untested). Achtung! formation drags (soft, untested). INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded. CE out of scope.

## Status
2026-07-23 run #70: found + fixed Robots++ dock error loop (ThinkNode shape + missing map check) and dead fence patch (param names). Compile green — RELAUNCH NEEDED for verification (current session runs the old dll). Outstanding: translation-report audit, palette pin watch, art bake fold-in, brainstorm levers, mech escort test, settings preview pass, landmark UI check, Forced smoke-vent gen, bond/home, VCHE run, soak, publishing prep.
